# TrustyTabs

`Navigation` · composition depth: `base`

A tab strip with panels. Each tab's 'value' doubles as the name of the slot holding its panel; leave the slot out and you get a strip-only tab you drive externally through v-model. Tabs take labels, icons, and per-tab disabling, and the strip can run down either side for a vertical layout.

**Use it when**
- one region swaps between a few peer views the user flips between.

**Don't use it for**
- groups that may all stand open at once: use TrustyAccordion
- hierarchical content: use TrustyTree
- many views: the strip runs out of room long before a list would
- a value the user sets rather than a view they switch to: use TrustyToggleGroup

```ts
import { TrustyTabs } from '@louislp/trusty-ui'
```

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `tabs` | `{ value: T; label?: string \| undefined; icon?: `${string}:${string}` \| undefined; disabled?: boolean \| undefined; }[]` | *required* | The tabs, in order. Each tab: - `value`: unique value v-model reports for the active tab; also the name of the slot that fills this tab's panel (one named slot per value; omit the slot to render no panel — strip-only, content driven externally via v-model) - `label`: text (omit for icon-only — then `value` is its a11y name) - `icon`: icon name (Iconify `collection:icon`, e.g. `ph:gear`) - `disabled`: disable just this tab |
| `placement` | `"top" \| "right" \| "left"` | `"top"` |  |
| `size` | `"md" \| "lg" \| "xl"` | `"md"` |  |
| `modelValue` | `T` | — |  |

## Events

- `update:modelValue` — `[value: T \| undefined]`

## Examples in Storybook

- Default — Default horizontal tabs. Panels fill named slots keyed by each `value`.
- KeyboardNavigation — Interaction test — clicking a tab swaps the panel, arrow keys move along the strip skipping the disabled tab, and only the selected trigger is in the tab order (roving tabindex). This is the behaviour Reka's Tabs primitive gives us; the test is here to catch a regression that quietly takes it away.
- Left — Strip on the left — vertical; arrow keys go up/down. Border/indicator on its right edge.
- Right — Strip on the right — mirror of `left`; border/indicator flip to its left edge.
- Large — `lg` scale — taller triggers, 14px labels.
- ExtraLarge — `xl` scale — tallest triggers, 18px labels, 24px icons.
- StripOnly — Strip only — no panel slots. Drive content living outside the component via `v-model`.
- DisabledTab — A disabled tab is skipped by keyboard nav and can't be activated.
- Icons — Icon + label tabs.
- VerticalIconsOnly — Vertical icon-only strip — no labels; each `value` is the tab's accessible name.
- VerticalIcons — Vertical strip with icons — same icon-beside-label row as horizontal tabs.
